## Flagship Production Systems (11 Core Architectures)

1. **V.I.S.A.R. E.D.G.E.**
   - **Type**: Autonomous Distributed AI Operating Mesh & Desktop Flagship
   - **Description**: Autonomous AI operating mesh engineered for local desktop hardware. Powered by a pure Python asynchronous kernel featuring a 10.2 microsecond Synapse IPC event bus, dynamic multi-agent swarms (4.82ms turnaround), quad cognitive brain modes (AUTO, FAST, AGENTIC, SUPERVISOR), 6-sense nervous system, 5-tier holographic memory, and unlimited Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool integration with two-tier human-in-the-loop safety gates.
   - **Status**: Beta Soon
   - **Categories**: ai-core, desktop, fullstack
   - **Tech Stack**: Python Async Kernel, PySide6, Multi-Agent Swarms, MCP Hub, FAISS / SQLite FTS5
   - **Web Hub**: https://visaredge.vercel.app/

2. **OrbitSpan**
   - **Type**: 3D Planetary Scale, Real-Time Ephemeris & Newtonian Gravity Engine
   - **Description**: Interactive 3D astrophysics engine calculating real-time planetary positions using NASA's VSOP87 analytical theory, computing true Newtonian gravitational pull on user body mass (F = G·M·m / r²), and converting cosmic distances into human-scale physical benchmarks. Features high-framerate Three.js R185 WebGL rendering, PWA offline caching, and walkable city-scale models.
   - **Categories**: frontend, ai-core
   - **Tech Stack**: TypeScript, React 19, Three.js, VSOP87 Ephemeris, Tailwind CSS, PWA
   - **Web App**: https://orbitspan.vercel.app/
   - **Repository**: https://github.com/RootDeveloperDS/Orbit-Span

3. **Frame My Avatar**
   - **Type**: Client-Side Curved Text Avatar & Profile Frame Generator
   - **Description**: High-performance client-side avatar framing studio for crafting circular profile picture frames with customizable curved typography, 4 perimeter watermark accents (Ribbon Trim, Crown Halo, Upper Quadrant, Radial Contour), multi-ring status palettes (#OPENTOWORK, #HIRING), full URL state serialization, and 1080x1080 HD PNG exports with embedded tEXt metadata. 100% private with zero server uploads.
   - **Categories**: frontend, dev-tool
   - **Tech Stack**: TanStack Start, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Radix UI, Canvas 2D
   - **Web App**: https://framemyavatar.vercel.app/
   - **Codebase**: Proprietary / Closed Source

4. **J.A.R.V.I.S. (Mark 1 - 21)**
   - **Type**: Voice-Enabled AI Assistant Ecosystem (21 Iterations)
   - **Description**: Comprehensive voice-enabled AI assistant capable of executing deep system-level commands and opening local applications. Integrated conversational AI models facilitate reliable task execution across iterations.
   - **Categories**: ai-core, desktop
   - **Tech Stack**: Python, SpeechRecognition, OpenAI, Tkinter
   - **Repository**: https://github.com/RootDeveloperDS/J.A.R.V.I.S./

5. **V.I.S.A.R. Edge Mobile**
   - **Type**: Native Android HUD & PC Telemetry Daemon
   - **Description**: Remote control ecosystem. Native Android Jetpack Compose client features a 3-tier boot timeline and a 60Hz holographic trackpad. Zero-overhead Python PC companion daemon manages real-time hardware telemetry streams, secure Drop-Pod multi-file transfers, and zero-latency acoustic audio pipelines.

   - **Categories**: mobile, desktop, api
   - **Tech Stack**: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Python, FastAPI, WebSockets

6. **VISAR Intel**

## Archive & Specialized Systems (12 Systems)

12. **Git Uncommitted Scanner (scanrepos)**
    - **Type**: Cross-Platform CLI & Interactive TUI Utility (PyPI Package)
    - **Description**: Lightning-fast, cross-platform CLI and TUI utility that recursively deep-scans directories to instantly locate Git repositories with pending uncommitted changes, untracked files, and unpushed commits. Features an interactive Neon-Cyan Textual terminal UI, Rich progress tables, and one-command pip/uvx distribution on PyPI.
    - **Categories**: dev-tool, automation
    - **Tech Stack**: Python 3.9+, Typer, Rich, Textual (TUI), PyPI, Git CLI
    - **PyPI Package**: https://pypi.org/project/git-uncommitted-scanner/
    - **Repository**: https://github.com/RootDeveloperDS/git-uncommitted-scanner

13. **FormEase**
    - **Type**: Zero-Upload Client-Side Document & Exam Photo Formatter
    - **Description**: Privacy-first, 100% browser-based photo, signature, and document formatter & compressor engineered for government, visa, and entrance exam portals (UPSC, SSC, State PSC). Automatically handles strict pixel dimensions, target file size bounds (KB/MB), and format conversion entirely in client memory without uploading sensitive identity data to external servers.
    - **Categories**: frontend, dev-tool
    - **Tech Stack**: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Canvas API, Web Workers
    - **Web App**: https://formease.deployxa.online/
    - **Repository**: https://github.com/RootDeveloperDS/FormEase

14. **NetSage AI (Cisco-AICTE VIP 2026)**
    - **Type**: AI-Assisted Cisco Network Troubleshooter with Human Review
    - **Description**: Dual-engine hybrid network diagnostic platform built for the Cisco-AICTE Virtual Internship Program (VIP 2026) at Gyan Ganga Institute of Technology & Sciences (GGITS). Combines a deterministic rule checker with 26 regex parsers scanning raw Cisco IOS CLI outputs alongside context-constrained LLM diagnostics enforcing strict JSON schemas and verbatim evidence citation. Features an interactive Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) Streamlit review portal for NOC engineers.
    - **Categories**: ai-core, dev-tool
    - **Tech Stack**: Python 3.10+, Streamlit, Cisco IOS CLI, Plotly, LLM Prompting, Regex Engine
    - **Repository**: https://github.com/RootDeveloperDS/DevanshSharma-GGITS-AI

15. **VISAR Edge Wake Word Model**
    - **Type**: Offline Neural Wake-Word Engine for Indian Phonetics
    - **Description**: Custom offline neural wake-word detection engine fine-tuned for Indian phonetics (Devanagari 'वि-सार' / 'Vee-saar'). Convolved with MIT Room Impulse Responses (RIRs) and calibrated against 96 real-world microphone telemetry samples to achieve 80.4% accuracy, 61.2% recall, and ultra-low false positive rate (~0.35/hr). Exports production runtime inference graphs in ONNX and TensorFlow Lite with weights hosted on Hugging Face.
    - **Categories**: ai-core
    - **Tech Stack**: PyTorch, openWakeWord, ONNX, TFLite, Audio DSP, MIT RIRs
    - **Model Weights**: https://huggingface.co/RootDeveloperDS/Visar_OpenWakeWord_Model
    - **Repository**: https://github.com/RootDeveloperDS/VISAR_OpenWakeWord_Model_Train

16. **VISAR EDGE V0.5**
